questions.text: For each of the items (i) - (xv), choose the correct answer from among the given alternatives and write its letter beside the item number in the answer booklet(s) provided. ( 15 marks )

Which source of historical information is this? Oral traditions Archives Museum Archaeology Linguistics Choose Answer : - -

A After the birth of Charles Darwin who introduced the theory of evolution B After the publication of the book "The Origin Species" in 1859 C After the discovery of man's remains by Dr. Leakey at Olduvai Gorge D After the scientific discovery of Homo-Habilis and Homo-Erectus E After the spread of religious books like the Quran and the Bible Choose Answer : - -

Why salt making industries were important in pre-colonial Africa? A It enabled people to eat uncooked food B It facilitated the development of heavy industries C It played a vital role in food preservation and healing D It enabled some societies to make ornaments of copper alloys E It was a source of vitamins Choose Answer : - -

The range of productive activities that man perfonns is determined by A nature of the environment and the productive forces. B strong standing army and modern weapons. C major means of production and cheap labour. D availability of raw materials and markets. E presence of offensive and defensive forces. Choose Answer : - -

Which one among the following descriptions illustrates best the objectives of colonial education in Africa? A TO get cheap laborers, raw materials and area of investment B To enable the Africans to get good treatment, housing and white color job C To get the producers of raw materials, cheap workers and puppets D To facilitate the activities of traders, missionaries and explores E To enable the Africans to become investors, chiefs and governors - - (xi) The military alliance which was for-med between Germany, Italy and Japan before the Second World War was known as A Triple Alliance. Arrange the following events in chronological order by writing number 1 to 6 besides the item number in the answer booklet(s) provided.
By 1880s the scramble for Africa had reached serious proportions. There were signs that if this scramble was not regulated war would erupt among the European powers.
In order to avert war, Chancellor Otto Von Bismarck of Germany called an International Conference of European Powers with interests in Africa.
The countries that were represented at the conference included Germany, Britain, France, Portugal, Belgium, Italy, Spain, Denmark and the United States of America.
The Berlin conference introduced the principles of effective occupation of colonies, hence paving the way for the colonization of the African continent.
The Berlin conference led to economic growth for most European nations since they were assured of maximum supply of raw materials, cheap labour and markets for their industrial manufactured goods.
By the late 1870s much of Africas interior was known to Europes capitalist interests through the services of explorers and missionaries. (12 marks) View Ans
